artifacts.purpose: Explicit protected dependencies and completed retirement selections
artifacts.schema: schemas/storage-retention.schema.json
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: tools/storage_retention.py
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the registry from the private companion main history

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current registry; a completed job does not authorize deleting its protected outputs.

artifacts.purpose: Run state transitions and holdout cadence
artifacts.schema: tools/sie/events.py and tools/sie/state.py event readers
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Resume, replay and accepted-run history
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore exact event bytes from the private companion main history

retention_rule.rule: Keep all events for active runs and supported recovery; never truncate an event chain.

artifacts.purpose: Complete current execution and rollback dependency
artifacts.schema: DATA.md and the corresponding tools/sie reader
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current run, holdout and supported rollback
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the complete dependency closure, not a digest or summary

retention_rule.rule: Keep while the run or a promised rollback can read it; no automatic eviction.

retention_rule.rule: Keep selected final research and every unique cited dependency regardless of age.

artifacts.purpose: Rebuildable scratch and cached observations
artifacts.schema: Producer-specific temporary format
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current stage only
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate through the original producer

retention_rule.rule: Remove only with stopped writers and released dependencies. New scratch admission stops at 2000 files or 128 MiB; new runs stop at 32 retained run directories.
